headline:
لعبة Dome Keeper قادمة
إلى PS5 وجهاز Switch
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Dome Keeper, the mining and base-defence roguelike, reaches PS5 and Switch on 14 December
angle.why_now: Raw Fury's showcase gave the console date on 12 Nov, a month out
angle.what_it_means_here: It is already on Xbox, PC and phones; console price not stated; Steam page lists Arabic

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: Raw Fury press release as carried by Inven Global read in full (Raw Fury's own site shows no post, so source_type secondary), Gematsu and Techtroduce read, Steam appdetails read 13 Nov; Nintendo Everything says 4 Dec (outlier, 14 Dec in the other three)
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: ledger grep newsroom/stories and jobs, no Dome Keeper
reel_check.SOURCE: age: yes: first report Gematsu 12 Nov 11:31 AM EST, under 24 h at the 12:15 Dubai slot
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: angle in the story file and job
reel_check.STORY TYPE announcement: yes: date, platforms, price not announced, where it already runs
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: headline names Dome Keeper, L1 Raw Fury, L2 the game type and developer, L3 the platforms it already runs on
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: تصدر for the date, قادمة إلى for the platforms; no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY: names match names-ar.md: yes: ريف فيوري and بيبينبتس added to names-ar.md with the Latin in the credit
